entities.name: Sedris
entities.description: The most powerful lich on Grixis, once the righteous king of Vithia who fell to demons and became a lich warlord ruling Sedraxis.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Former Shard of Alara cut off from white and green mana; also the Vithian word for traitor.

entities.name: Vithia
entities.description: A kingdom with a caste system and focus on knighthood and chivalry, ruled by Sedris, overrun by demons and undead.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Tempted Sedris with dreams of power; gained power on Grixis.

entities.name: Vithia's paladins
entities.description: Knights who fled the kingdom shouting "Grixis".

entities.name: Sedraxis
entities.description: Former Vithian capital turned the greatest necropolis on the plane.

events.summary: Grixis is separated from the rest of Alara and cut off from white and green mana; demons and necromancers gain power.
events.quote: the demons and necromancers gained power in the ensuing chaos

events.summary: Tempted by demons with dreams of power, Sedris submits, hands thousands of innocents to them, kills his family and advisors and performs a ritual to become a lich.
events.quote: Sedris handed thousands of innocents over to the demons, killed his own family and advisors

events.summary: Vithia's paladins, unable to stop him, flee the kingdom with "Grixis" on their lips.
events.quote: Vithia's paladins , unable to stop the fallen monarch, fled the kingdom

events.summary: Vithia is overrun by demons and undead and its capital becomes the necropolis Sedraxis, ruled by Sedris.
events.quote: the capital was transformed into Sedraxis , the now greatest necropolis on the plane

relations.quote: Sedris was once the good and righteous king of Vithia
Sedris still rules this dark city of the dead
when demons tempted him with dreams of power, he submitted
